g.text: 66 components / 42 nets / 4-layer. Bluetooth vibrator controller: nRF52840 module, USB-C charger with power path, two low-side motor channels from VSYS, HX711 load-cell ADC and a pressure-sensor port on a switched 3.3 V rail. Power rails are power symbols; only cross-block signals use global labels. Generated from scripts/circuit.py — do not hand-edit; rebuild with `python3 build.py --only schematic`.

g.desc: 66 components / 42 nets / 4-layer. Bluetooth vibrator controller: nRF52840 module, USB-C charger with power path, two low-side motor channels from VSYS, HX711 load-cell ADC and a pressure-sensor port on a switched 3.3 V rail. Power rails are power symbols; only cross-block signals use global labels. Generated from scripts/circuit.py — do not hand-edit; rebuild with `python3 build.py --only schematic`.
